== Summary ==
Identified: [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (grey hair, black tee, and cargo shorts; same face, hair, and shorts as in [[:File:2025 European Championship 17.jpg]] and [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]]) and [[Emil Wallin]] (black pocket tee; same face and shirt as [[:File:2025 European Championship 18.jpg]]). The player in a white tee and glasses, seen mostly from behind, is not named.
